- scripts/security_audit.sh:243-260 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `elif security_audit_flag_enabled "${SECURITY_AUDIT_INCREMENTAL}"` branch is syntactically invalid because it follows a standalone assignment instead of the preceding `if` block’s `then`/`fi` structure.
  WHY: Bash would fail to parse the script, preventing the security audit from running at all.

  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists "ai:retro" "${target_repo}" || return 1` can still surface transient GitHub API failures as hard job failures inside retro fan-out.
  WHY: A rate-limit/network/permission blip can make the outer loop fail non-zero when all consumers hit the same transient error, stalling the weekly retro fan-out.
